characters.form: Genetically revised human male glider with arm-to-flank biological membranes; no extra limbs

storyAppearance.anatomy: Adult man with elongated arms and dark biological gliding-sail membranes. Arrival left membrane folds cleanly, right drags with outer edge thickening to skin; rear membranes trap heat. Pupils expanded, black heat-patches throat/ribs, flickering temple capillaries; right landing foot broad, left narrowing. Wrist device. After stabilization pupils contract, heat patches fade brown, jaw shortens somewhat, RIGHT arm membrane recedes to elbow and pauses; ordinary breath/heat/even hearing, not full baseline restoration. Final strap beneath elbow membrane and quiet temple pulses.
storyAppearance.proportions: Adult about40, lean elongated-limbed brown-skinned male body, narrow shaved dark head, angular jaw that is somewhat shorter after stabilization. Two arms/two legs only, sail skin from extended arm to flank/back, NO separate bird/bat wings or extra finger-bones. Modest dark flexible knee-length shorts with open side accommodation, bare feet. Wrist device small dark band; capillary light is subtle red early and amber late.
storyAppearance.equipment: Two LARGE useful whole-body three-quarter views clearly labeled ARRIVAL and STABILIZED. Arrival front shows elongated arms, left sail neatly folded, right lower edge uneven and long, asymmetric broad right/narrow left feet, black throat/rib heat patches and nearly-black pupils. Stabilized view turned slightly shows the RIGHT arm membrane now stops at elbow with strap beneath the remnant, remaining left folded membrane still present, brown patches, reduced pupils, steady amber temple arc. One side-head portrait for each state. No full-human reset, no invented cured wings, no humanoid uniform poses, no flying scene, floor marks or isolated hand study. Keep membrane silhouette complete within sheet.
